_definitions.auroc_mw: Submitted code rule (scripts/indices.py line 46): AUROC = (C + 0.5*ties)/(n0*n1), Mann-Whitney with 0.5 tie credit; undefined only when correctness is constant; = .5 exactly when confidence is constant and correctness varies. Numbers equal the submitted results (baseline rerun).
_definitions.auroc_prereg: Rule written in analysis_plan.md section 2 and in the submitted manuscript text: AUROC undefined when confidence OR correctness is constant (then identical to gamma's undefined set). Sensitivity rerun, same seeds.
_definitions.gamma: Goodman-Kruskal gamma, (C - D)/(C + D); undefined when C + D = 0 (constant confidence or constant correctness). Same in both runs.
_definitions.forced_05: Cells where confidence is constant and correctness varies: AUROC = .5 under auroc_mw, undefined under auroc_prereg; equals gamma_undefined - auroc_mw_undefined exactly.
_definitions.full: share of students whose index is undefined on their full N-response set (practitioner-facing incomputability)
_definitions.halves: share undefined in split half A (random: students x 50 splits; temporal: earlier half), which governs exclusion
_definitions.minN: N at which the reliability curve first reaches the threshold, log-linear interpolation between grid points; '>200' = not reached within the grid; CI = bootstrap percentile over students (B = 1000, joint across the Design A grid); a CI of [x, None] means some draws never cross (upper bound > 200)

code_treatment.conclusion: Submitted code: AUROC = Mann-Whitney U/(n1*n0) with 0.5 tie credit; defined whenever both correct and incorrect responses exist; equals exactly .5 when confidence is constant and correctness varies. Gamma is NaN iff C + D = 0, i.e. constant confidence or constant correctness.
code_treatment.manuscript_text_claim: Gamma and AUROC are undefined whenever a student shows no variance in confidence or in correctness (Method, Indices and the Undefined-Value Protocol)
code_treatment.text_vs_code: text and plan state auroc_prereg; code computed auroc_mw; all submitted AUROC numbers are auroc_mw numbers
